# Leap Start Early Learning Child Care - Southern River

> A premium early childhood education center in Southern River offering STEAM-based learning through the Accelerated Neuro Response approach across three age-based programs (Nursery, Toddler, and Kindy hubs).

Leap Start Early Learning provides comprehensive child care services for infants through pre-kindergarten children, emphasizing innovative STEAM education, inclusive learning, and community engagement. The center features specialized programs, secure facilities, onsite meal preparation, and a commitment to school readiness.

## Key Topics

- STEAM Learning
- Accelerated Neuro Response (ANR)
- Early Years Learning Framework (EYLF)
- Nursery Hub (Birth-2 years)
- Toddler Hub (2-3 years)
- Kindy Hub (3-6 years)
- School Readiness
- Child-Centered Curriculum
- Security and Safety
- Community Playgroups
- Onsite Nutrition
- Specialist Education Programs
- Inclusive Learning
- Parent Engagement
- Southern River Location

## Educational Philosophy & Approach

- [Leap Start Difference](https://www.leapstartchildcaresouthernriver.com.au/leap-start-difference): Leap Start's unique Accelerated Neuro Response approach and educational philosophy
- [Leap Start Southern River Centre Philosophy](https://www.leapstartchildcaresouthernriver.com.au/centre-philosophy): Centre philosophy supporting families with STEAM and inclusive learning programs
- [STEAM Learning-Based Program](https://www.leapstartchildcaresouthernriver.com.au/steam-learning-based-program): STEAM curriculum with Accelerated Neuro Response and hands-on learning approach
- [A Better Way to Teach and Learn](https://www.leapstartchildcaresouthernriver.com.au/teaching-and-learning): ANR approach with STEAM learning, arts, and child-centered curriculum philosophy
- [8 Specialist Education Programs](https://www.leapstartchildcaresouthernriver.com.au/8-specialist-education-programs): Eight specialist programs including STEAM, performing arts, and language education

## Age-Based Care Programs

- [Nursery Hub From Birth to 2 Years](https://www.leapstartchildcaresouthernriver.com.au/nursery-hub): Infant care program for birth to 2 years with facility tour and reviews
- [Toddler Hub Ages 2-3](https://www.leapstartchildcaresouthernriver.com.au/toddler-hub): Toddler care program for ages 2-3 with parent reviews and facility information
- [Kindy Hub Ages 3-6](https://www.leapstartchildcaresouthernriver.com.au/kindy-hub): Kindergarten program for ages 3-6 with school readiness and pre-kindy preparation
- [Ensuring Your Child is Ready for School](https://www.leapstartchildcaresouthernriver.com.au/ensuring-your-child-is-ready-for-school): School readiness through STEAM learning and ANR curriculum approach

## Facilities & Environment

- [Leap Start Early Learning Child Care Southern River Facilities](https://www.leapstartchildcaresouthernriver.com.au/facilities): Facility overview with age-appropriate rooms, STEAM curriculum, and safety features
- [Unique and Safe Play Environment](https://www.leapstartchildcaresouthernriver.com.au/unique-and-safe-play-environment): Outdoor play environment with STEAM learning and sun-safe policies for children
- [Security and Safety for Your Child](https://www.leapstartchildcaresouthernriver.com.au/security-and-safety-for-your-child): CCTV monitoring, electronic security, and swipe card access control systems
- [Fresh, Nutritious Onsite Prepared Meals](https://www.leapstartchildcaresouthernriver.com.au/child-care-food): Onsite kitchen with fresh meals, dietary requirements, and food safety standards
